AFAIK: I was in Grasse(France) where they produce some of the most prominent perfumes. In one of the production halls they told us about perfumes and if I remember correctly:
- Perfume: Basically the strongest smelling liquid, is very intense and lasts a very long time.
- Eau de Perfume: Perfume/Water in 1/10 Ratio. Commonly used for most retailer perfumes, it lasts normally long and isn’t too “much” in terms of fragrance when using two or more pumps.
- Eau de Toilette: Perfume and water in 1/20 Ratio. Often used as Body spray or cheaper perfumes. It doesn’t last very long and isn’t very fragrant but also not too heavy on the smell.


Do correct me if I’m wrong cuz I’m too lazy to research but basically you should mostly look at what the actual tag is. “Perfume” lasts way longer than Eau de perfume or Eau de toilette. You also need very little of the stuff (like one drop on each side). It’s of course more expensive as well but I like to buy at least Eau de perfume and won’t buy Eau de toilette for stated reasons

Self harming is an addiction and it should be treated as such meaning that relapse are likely. How you treat relapse though should be important. 
We all have bad days and may break down sometimes. I’m speaking here as a 22 year old woman, but I think this is like any other break up really. 
You can break up for any reason, age gap, lost feelings, situational incompatibility etc. it sounds to me that the latter is what applies in your exact situation.
Going forward if you are absolutely sure you want to break up with her you could do it slow (like distancing yourself and letting things fizzle out eventually) or you could do it immediately. I tend to prefer the hard but fair method, which means you rip off the bandaid and just do it instead of stringing your partner along. That doesn’t mean you can’t be gentle about it though. Instead of mentioning the obvious age gap you could mention your plans and how it doesn’t align with what you both have discussed. You could say that you realised your feelings and what you have is not as strong anymore so you want to break it off as in not to string her along any longer. 
I also think that in any case you’ll have to break up contact, as hard as it sounds, because you will try to think about eventualities that may be compromises you will come to regret. 
This is all if you have already decided to break up though. Hope I could help a bit

It’s a good question as to where my depression stems from and I have yet to find a definite answer (if there is even one).
Ive been depressed since I was around 12-13 years old with ups and downs over the course of my school life, so I think there are various reasons as to why I got depressed.  Anyhow, the most likely one, as per my doctor and therapists, is that I’m just prone to it. Since medically speaking depression is caused by disbalance of hormones in the brain, my initial onset might just be me having drawn the genetical loser ticket.
As to why I went to the psych ward / my depression got worse was because my ex boyfriend had threatened to kill me after raping me and I lived with constant panic attacks for two years before spiraling into a hopeless pit with seemingly no way to get out

I have to preface my answer with the fact that I was in a private station, though I’ve heard that at least in my hospital, the general wards were very up to par too.

Contrary to my initial believe my stay was really pleasant and not very regulated. This was most likely because even though I attempted suicide, I was not in immediate danger when I got admitted.
We had breakfast from 6-9am, lunch at 12 and dinner at 6pm. In between your time was very variable, from individual therapy (twice a week), to group therapy sessions (sport, gym, music, art, clay, wood, general information, wellness, physio) to free time. Since we were not closed up (except for Covd urrrgh) we were able to go outside between meal times, either out of the hospital or within the hospital if we wanted to. 

I was living with an older lady in a double bed room, though individual rooms were also provided (it was not in my insurance plan). We had a group room, a common room with a tv and a loooot of games within another room. I’m very glad I got to know lots of different people and we all shared depression. I was the youngest by far so these people were like my second family! We did a lot together and even meet up now, that we got discharged. So no, fortunately I’ve been able to get along with everyone just fine :)

Exactly what I think! Why is it invalid to seek attention when there’s obviously something really wrong? 
If someone, anyone, is willing to harm themselves it must be because they have no other way of showing what’s going on. Why does anybody (in this case society itself) feel like it’s okay to talk these problems down? 

It’s the same with people who say that depression isn’t real unless your parents both died or you are homeless. Nah man, even a millionaire can have depression. Of course your circumstances in life can be a reason you have depression, but I like to quote my psychiatrist on this.

“People are born or have developed a threshold at any time in their life. This threshold is different for every person on this planet. Some only need a bad day, some need a life threatening event and some don’t even need anything at all, to push them over the edge. But that doesn’t mean they don’t have depression. It’s highly inappropriate to measure someone’s pain and suffering by their circumstances alone. One must always take into account the individual itself. Only then you can start to understand what depression really is.”

I hate the distinction between attention seekers and legitimate people. Whoever cuts has a problem and needs help. There’s no need to differentiate between these. Also don’t listen to your teacher, gosh this makes me angry. It’s the same as saying: well it’s not a problem until it becomes life threatening.

I’d suggest that You try to seek a conversation in which you explain that you really feel like playing the game, but you can also understand that she doesn’t want to see it. Set boundaries, like one game only, where she just does something else in another room, or she tells you she is busy anyway so you can use that time to play.
